parsed.name: FPGA寄存器通信接口
parsed.description: 用于通过 USB 与 FPGA 设备进行寄存器级读写的非物理软件接口组件。它在实验系统中提供底层地址访问、连接状态检查以及获取底层设备对象的能力，适合用于控制或调试依赖 FPGA 的仪器模块。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software interface component for register-level communication with an FPGA over USB. In laboratory systems, it provides low-level address read/write access, connection checking, and access to the underlying device object, making it useful for controlling or debugging FPGA-based instrument modules.

actions.description: 检查该通信接口是否已连接到 USB 端口。
actions.description_en: Check whether this communication interface is connected to a USB port.

actions.description: 获取该接口当前关联的底层设备对象。
actions.description_en: Get the underlying device object associated with this interface.

actions.description: 向指定地址写入数值，以执行 FPGA 的底层寄存器写操作。
actions.description_en: Write a value to a specified address to perform a low-level FPGA register write.

actions.description: 从指定地址读取数据，以执行 FPGA 的底层寄存器读操作。
actions.description_en: Read data from a specified address to perform a low-level FPGA register read.
